gloss: black soybeans; sweet simmered black beans (New Year dish)

definitions.gloss: black soybeans; sweet simmered black beans
definitions.explanation: A black variety of soybean, and by extension the glossy sweet-simmered beans made from it that appear in every osechi box at New Year. Also sold roasted and as tea.

examples.japanese: おせちの{黒豆|くろまめ}はつやつやしていた。
examples.english: The black beans in the osechi were beautifully glossy.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{毎年|まいとし}、{暮|く}れになると{黒豆|くろまめ}を{一晩|ひとばん}{水|みず}につけてから{時間|じかん}をかけて{煮|に}る。
examples.english: Every year at the end of December my grandmother soaks black beans overnight and then simmers them slowly.

notes:
One of the {祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}, the core celebratory dishes of osechi. The bean is eaten as a wordplay wish: まめ also means "healthy, diligent," so the dish stands for a year of good health and hard work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒豆|くろまめ}を{煮|に}る: to simmer black beans
- つやつやの{黒豆|くろまめ}: glossy black beans
- {黒豆|くろまめ}{茶|ちゃ}: black soybean tea

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大豆|だいず}: soybean — the ordinary yellow variety used for tofu and miso
- {小豆|あずき}: adzuki bean — red, used for sweet bean paste, not part of osechi
